# Rrjeti Agency

> Rrjeti Agency is a marketing agency in Prishtina, Kosovo. It is the first agency in Kosovo to offer percentage-based marketing: it works as a business's full marketing department (Meta ads, content for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, photo, video and websites) and is paid 10% of the client's gross monthly revenue, with the ad budget paid out of that 10%.

## Key facts
- Model: 10% of gross monthly revenue, measured before expenses. Example: €10,000 gross revenue = €1,000 a month.
- About 40% of the fee goes straight into Meta (Instagram and Facebook) ads for the client; about 35% into photo, video, design and website; the rest into strategy, management and reporting.
- Who qualifies: service businesses (clinics, laboratories, salons, restaurants, repair shops) with at least €5,000 gross revenue a month.
- Product businesses or those under €5,000 a month can work with Rrjeti for a fixed monthly price instead, with the same team and quality.
- One partner per industry per city: Rrjeti does not take on a client's direct local competitor.
- 35+ partners so far, 500+ posts published, millions of views generated, work across 10+ industries; about 80% of partners stay long-term.
- Clients include Gyno Center Kosova, Vicianum Green Farm, Eliesa Krasniqi Clinic, Labor Laboratori, Pulmo Center Kosova, Orto Furniture, DADA, Rio, Pizzeria Dielli and others.
- Has supported Chili House (chili-house.com) behind the scenes, mainly with design, on projects for Droboost, Edoni 7, iTransport & Logistics, Kärcher Center Danfos, Kia Kosova, Spitex AlbaSwiss Care and Bosch. Most of the credit for those projects belongs to Chili House.
- Languages: Albanian and English.

## Results (case studies)
- Gyno Center Kosova, first month (12 Oct – 12 Nov 2026): unique weekly TikTok viewers ×2.8 (24,500 → 69,300), Instagram weekly reach ×2.3, 143 messages from ads at €1.70 per message (previously ~€4).
- Vicianum Green Farm: from zero online sales to 270+ online orders with €670 in ads (≈€2.5 per order), 1M+ views, 1,600+ new followers.
- Orto Furniture: phone-first online catalog with a bottom “pill” menu (https://ortofurniture-ks.com/).
